headline: Gas stations warn about fuel prices in October: "There will be an unprecedented increase in diesel"
summary: The Spanish confederation of service station entrepreneurs (CEEES) warned of an unprecedented increase in diesel prices in October. It called on the government to intervene in what it describes as an unsustainable situation.
why: Diesel prices affect transport and logistics costs across the economy, and government intervention in fuel markets can change pump prices and retailer margins.

original_headline: Las gasolineras advierten de los precios de los carburantes en octubre: «Habrá un encarecimiento sin precedentes en el gasóleo»
